About This Game

Two falling-piece puzzles. One controller.
Can you play both at once?




DROPANIC is a single-player puzzle game where one set of controls moves every active board together.

Let's give it a try.


Clear block lines. Chain matching jewels.
Move. Rotate. Drop. Both boards, together.

Got it? Now try four.




Still just one controller.
Keep every board alive. If any one fills up, the run ends.

Choose your challenge.


  • Stages — 88 stages. Complete all five missions to clear each one.
  • Endless — Choose 2–4 boards and your starting speed. Chase your personal best as the pace rises.
  • Random Challenge — Two boards. Five random missions. Reroll before you start.

Play with a keyboard or controller. Supports 17 languages, including English and Japanese.

Think you can? Let's find out.
